 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice S. B. Pd. Singh
 Oral Order

The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with complaint case No. 1063 of 2021 for the offence under Sections 498A, 323, 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. As agreed between the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation and Concilliation Center,
Patna High Court, Patna where petitioner as well as O.P. No. 2 shall appear in person on 24.02.2025.

3. Put up this matter on 18.03.2025, along with the report of Mediation and Concilliation Centre,
Patna High Court, Patna.
4.
During pendency of this application, the interim Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.45860 of 2024(5) dt.05-02-2025 relief granted to the petitioner shall continue.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) prabhakar/-
